comment: Independent C-first route for a source-created statue trap. In wizard debug mode, wish `statue trap` at the hero square; then move east off it and west back onto it. C source says readobjnam -> wizterrainwish calls maketrap(STATUE_TRAP), maketrap creates the living statue, and re-entry should dispatch the hero arm of trapeffect_statue_trap to activate_statue_trap. The C recording will establish which branch and monster outcome occur; no JavaScript result informed the inputs.
